item.title: ASTRAL-1 Astero
item.description:
Infobox The Anti-Structure Type Radiation Augmented Laser - 1 Astero is a laser guided torpedo designed by Matchik Technologies for use against modern orbital structures. Receptors positioned around the body of the torpedo detect electromagnetic radiation signals emitted from communication systems on board stations, platforms and satellites, before directing the laser guidance system in its direction. The Astero can be launched from both starships and orbital structures, but requires prior input from the launcher in order to properly identify targets.
The ASTRAL-1A was released in 2165 by Matchik Technologies to moderate success. Designed in spite of the decline in demand for torpedoes, Matchik Technologies was contracted by several private militaries to design a new torpedo to replace ageing models. Although not intended as a public product, the ASTRAL-1A was also advertised to the Kolban Alliance, but no purchases were made.
The ASTRAL-1B is a newer model of the Astero still in development. It will bring upgrades to the torpedo's precision and increase its explosive class to 6. It will not be purchased by the Kolban Alliance but is planned to be adopted by the Dottian military.

item.title: Reduction, Granule
item.description:
Infobox Granule Reduction is the code name for a Human man whose actual identity is unknown and kept secret, primarily known for his unique weapons designs that were picked up by SharpTack and a few other companies. Outside of this information, little is known about Reduction. He claims that he was born with a "genetic disorder that slowed his aging process", to explain his unusually long lifetime.In one of his few public statements made, Granule Reduction declared that he had decided to commit his life to making marginally viable weapons. This phrase “Marginally Viable Weapons” soon became the catchphrase associated with his designs. It is also possible that Reduction is not one person, but several, owing to his long lifetime and seemingly "endless" creativity.

item.title: Wilting, Bill
item.description:
Infobox Bill Wilting was a co-founder of Sideways Collective Industries, a starship manufacturing corporation part of the Symbiote Triangle and one of the most successful companies in the galaxy. He teamed up with his best friend Fraser Regull to form the company out of their own small savings. After a few decades the company had matured into a successful organisation, developing and manufacturing some of the most advanced technology in the Human astral territory. Some years later, Wilting and Regull also made it to the galactic stage. item.title: Sci-Fi World
item.description:
The Sci-Fi World is a large world-building passion project created and started in October of 2023. Inspired by the vast inner workings of long-running universes such as Star Wars and Dungeons & Dragons, it focusses on a small portion of a galaxy within a semi-hard science fiction universe, complete with star systems, planets, moons, cities and people. Technological and societal progression follows a similar timeline to the real world, with some differences to support recorded advancements. This database is set up to mimic a digital encyclopedia, fit with as much detailed information as possible in order to make it as comprehensive as it can be.
Back to indexThe Sci-Fi World was originally started on a Google Slide on the 14th of October, 2023 and remained as a Google Drive based project until the 17th of June, 2024, when work to migrate all created information to an Obsidian vault began. At this point, the Drive consisted of approximately 663 slides in two presentations and tens of thousands of words throughout several documents, all typed by hand. These numbers are expected to and will grow, albeit within the Obsidian database.It was intended around the end of that first October to turn content and elements of the Sci-Fi World into a Table-Top Role Playing Game, but due to the slow rate of progress and lack of overall interest, the idea was placed on hold. As of present, the Sci-Fi World remains almost exclusively as a world-building project. However, since update v1.3.2, work on this side of the project has been resumed.
The Sci-Fi World is set in a galaxy in which several different intelligence species (and many more primal fauna) dwell. Some of these species have begun venturing the universe while others are still tied to their own worlds of origin. Those that have found one another have formed a grand coalition named the Kolban Alliance and now experience a mostly stable peace, but not without a long history of battle and bloodshed (much of which occurred in a long, drawn out series of wars called the Cosmian Wars).There is always much to know and much to learn about the Sci-Fi World, so here are some good places to start:
General Information - Comprehensive information on the workings of the galaxy, society and more.
Background Information - Uncategorised information pertaining to small and specific parts of the Sci-Fi World's societal knowledge.
Galaxy - Information about every star system, planet and location of note in the galaxy.
History - Comprehensive information regarding significant events in the galaxy's past.
Races - Compiled information about the several intelligent species operating within the galaxy, both extinct and living.
People - Small amounts of information on specific notable people from all walks of life.
Nature - Information regarding the diverse natural wildlife and plants throughout the galaxy.
Organisations - General information focusing on the various organisations and businesses in the galaxy.
Technology - A directory to all the different types of developed technology invented throughout the galaxy's history. Alternatively, if you are looking for something new:
Aerolite - An extremely light material with a similarly extreme strength.
Autogenis - An ancient race believed to be extinct. It appears to have been advanced in interstellar travel.
Borfrice Bionics Engineering Company - The leading bionics development and manufacturing company.
Gerranne Procedure - A classified procedure in which planets are terraformed to be perfectly spherical.
Hitch Incident - The event most known for being the final push toward what would ultimately become known as the Cosmian Wars.
Pergot, Nivian - The founder of SharpTack, the weapons manufacturer.
Starships - Vehicles of many different shapes and sizes used to travel through the vast cosmos.
Terroxenarch - A large humanoid giant recently discovered to possibly exhibit intelligent behaviour.

item.title: Walkshire Wurm
item.description:
Infobox Walkshire Wurms are fully endemic to their namesake planet of Walkshire. They are the primary source of the unique cave systems under the hills of their home planet. About ten thousand unique individual specimens have been identified within the planet, but there are suspected to be at least one hundred thousand more.Walkshire Wurms are gigantic in size, with adults spanning up to 140 metres in length. They feature large mouths at the front of their body, which they use to ingest material ahead of them, similar to a whale consuming krill. Excretion of waste occurs at the other end, after passing through a long stomach and a simple series of intestines, which span approximately one half of the body.Like most worms, Walkshire Wurms "see" through sensory organs scattered across the grey within their outer layer of skin that detect vibrations and simple changes in light levels. However, these organs are highly sensitive and can be easily fried by direct contact with starlight.Walkshire Wurms have been observed to consciously avoid bright lights (including the light of Jolloy) and tend to stay below the surface for upwards of 28 hours at a time, only surfacing for long periods of time in the event of an earthquake or other possibly dangerous phenomena. From the moment they are born, Wurms act fully independently, spending the majority of their time moving through the crust of Walkshire, digesting the grass and minerals they eat.

item.title: Vleil, Simeritus
item.description:
Infobox Simeritus Vleil was the founder of Vleil Starworks, a once great starship manufacturer responsible for the first technology ever used by a Kolban-recognised civilisation to colonise a planet. The company and Vleil himself had limited involvement in the Cosmian Wars. A popular Dottian respected for his wisdom, Vleil did not support the ongoing wars as he felt they drew back on what both the Dottians and the Linc ultimately hoped to accomplish - peace and longevity. His company suffered as a result of this, losing many customers due to his refusal to involve himself with any of the involved parties. Despite his falling during the first decades of Cosmian Wars, Vleil inspired many of the following generations, including several of the founders of the modern starship corporations in operation today, which continue his long-lasting legacy.

item.title: Time System
item.description:
Before the creation of the Kolban Alliance, no solid universal system of tracking time had been introduced, with each civilisation using their own and refusing to change. Upon the signing of the Kolban Pact however, the need to do so became apparent. Universal time is now managed through the existence of the Galactic Time Constant (GTC). Individual planets may apply an offset to their local time according to daylight times.
The numerical year system is based off of how many years have passed since the first colonisation of new systems by the Dottians. This is designated as the Cosmic Era, or CE. Alternatively, events occurring before 0 CE are appropriately designated with Before Cosmic Era, or BCE. The remainder of the time units run according to the Human-invented system, with seconds serving as one of the Scientific Standard's base units.It is to be noted that the month of February is not 30 or 31 days in length. However, its length of 28 days (and 29 in leap years) has never been included in the Galactic Time Constant as an official unit. This is primarily due to the lack of full consistency in its application.
General Information

item.title: Terroxenarch
item.description:
Infobox Terroxenarchs are humanoid giants that, according to researchers involved in studying their behaviour and anatomy, will “eat anything that moves”. With only a few hundred known to exist, they are considered a rare and endangered species. Several captured specimens are kept in various zoo enclosures on a select few planets. The species itself originates from the planet Zebrox in the Kuloklav system.
Terroxenarchs are some of the tallest known wildlife species by pure height, with adults averaging at about 20 metres from head to toe. Featuring a majorly humanoid body structure, they are quite frequently related to Humans and Xanfer, despite sharing very little genetic information with the two races.Terroxenarch skin is rubbery and approximately one centimetre thick, making it difficult to cut or penetrate. This can make it hard to manage them in an enclosed habitat. Their immense physical strength furthers this, meaning rooms must be reinforced with stronger materials, ultimately making their artificial habitats costly to build and maintain.Given their large mass, Terroxenarchs consume several kilograms of organic matter a day. This can include trees, grass, meat and even their own flesh at times. It has been found that adults do not resort to autocannibalism when in danger of starving, but rather as a regular meal or even as part of a game.Several recent independent studies (including attempts to communicate through speech) have shown that adult Terroxenarchs are capable of exhibiting somewhat intelligent behaviour, which has prompted both members of the public and involved organisations to more seriously consider the ethical implications of their treatment.

item.description: Stations are orbital structures designed to act as central hubs of activity beyond a planet. They are one of the most common artificial space structures in the galaxy. Most orbital stations serve as an interchange between starships and atmospheric landing vehicles, while also being trading or residential facilities. item.title: Sideways Collective Industries
item.description:
Infobox Sideways Collective Industries (SCI) is a mining and starship manufacturing company part of the Symbiote Triangle. It was founded by the pocket money of Fraser Regull and Bill Wilting, two close Human friends. It is arguably the most successful manufacturing company in written history, a considerable feat for a relatively young business. SCI initially mined asteroid fields and constructed already existing starship designs to sell on an open market. Thanks to the constant huge demand for starfighters and small warships, the two were able to make huge sums of money.
However, Wilting wanted to design starships of his own. He created an initial design, complete with a combination of newly developed technology from various industries. This was eventually developed into the Otera line of starfighters named after the planet they grew up on, which soon became their centrepiece invention. From this point, the company only expanded, until it became the second most successful existing organisation in the galaxy - only behind the Rosten Company.
Organisations

item.title: SED Platform
item.description:
Infobox The Soup Extraction Drill Platform was the first known designed method of harvesting soup en masse. Several units were deployed upon the first discovery of Soup, and continued to run until the depletion of their deposits. Since the invention of the newer and far more effective SEG models by Mansteid Auto, the SED and its direct drilling method of collection has become completely obsolete. Some existing defunct platforms still sit abandoned on the surfaces of some planets.
Civilian Structures

item.title: SCI-700 Forrester
item.description:
Infobox The Sideways Collective Industries 500 Forrester is a twin engine, luxurious personal civilian starship manufactured by Sideways Collective Industries. The Forrester is primary designed for travel across individual planets, with onboard systems specialised for orbital behaviour. It is also capable of travel between planets, although its small size limits its fuel capacity and thus the maximum distance it can reliably travel in one trip.
Civilian Ships

item.title: SCI-144 Pipette
item.description:
Infobox The Sideways Collective Industries 144 Pipette is a short-range, small capacity, private civilian aircraft designed for short trips across low gravity atmospheric planets. It is sold to both public and private buyers in all areas of the galaxy. The relatively fuel-efficient jet engines used by the Pipette makes it favourable for cheaper flight costs and its low gaseous emission rate is resultant from newer recyclable exhaust technology.
Civilian Aircraft

item.title: Rosten, Derrick
item.description:
Infobox Derrick Rosten was the founder of the Rosten Company, now one of the largest retail companies in the galaxy. However, it never became a big business during his life, that accomplishment being carried out by his son Milo Rosten. Before Rosten could begin profiting from the then-small company, he was drafted into the Human military in 1680 during the Cosmian Wars. He was killed in action in 1690 on the planet of Lemminikist.
People

item.title: Political and Governmental System
item.description:
Infobox Most of the galaxy is interconnected within a major political hierarchy, stemming from the Kolban Alliance’s Kolban Council at the very top all the way down to the individual planet regional boards. The system is designed to create a complex web of interconnection between different levels of leadership to allow for efficient development without inhibiting the governments' ability to communicate with each other and with other third parties outside.At the bottom of the hierarchy lie the regional boards, who specifically oversee their designated section of a planet (could be as small as one tenth of the planet to as large as one quarter), such as infrastructure instalment and community management. One step above are the planetary councils, who tend to run the entire planet at a local level, from making and maintaining local laws to contracting and policing. If a system only has one planet, the planetary council usually does not operate.
Above the planetary councils are the system governments, who run and coordinate each planet in the star system as a whole. The majority of system governments report directly to their civil government. The civil government runs every system in an astral territory. For example, the Grandusk civil government runs every system that lies within the Grandusk astral territory. When referring to individual civil governments, the word “civil” is often omitted, making it Grandusk government, as an example.
Assuming one is part of the Kolban Alliance, the very peak of the hierarchy is the alliance itself, which maintains general order between each of the recognised races. The alliance is ultimately overseen and led by the Kolban Council, a collection of democratically elected members from every race recognised by the Kolban Pact. The Kolban Council itself has its own small hierarchy, divided based on the agreed relative power of each civilisation. The Co-Council consists of races recognised by the pact but who do not make significant enough contributions to the order of the galaxy. The Primary Council includes the main races involved with all processes.Every level of the political and governmental system in the galaxy contributes at least in small part to the stability of the controlled territories. Each one communicates mainly with the two above and below, but also have the ability to do so with any other level in an emergency.

item.title: Otera-B1 Sorcerer
item.description:
Infobox The Otera-Bomber 1 Sorcerer is a triple seat, twin-engine, light bomber starfighter developed for use above planets with no atmosphere and within orbital range of planets otherwise sustaining one. It was the first bomber in Sideways Collective Industries' Otera starfighter line, beginning production shortly after the I1A. Favoured for its simple and reliable design, the Sorcerer saw many years of service in many parts of the galaxy, even after new and improved designs were made. With an exclusive focus on bomb hardpoints and only rear-facing light Cirus GMAT Autocoils, early B1s required fighter escorts to accompany them on missions and destroy enemy starships. The Sorcerer is still produced by SCI, although in very low quantities.
The Otera-B1A was the original design of the Sorcerer line. It featured a minimal armament in order to keep a relatively low profile. One rear-facing Cirus GMAT Autocoil served as its only defensive armament, and the hardpoints could only mount medium and small size unguided bombs. Critics argued the B1A was too underdeveloped for its time, but SCI co-founder and designer Bill Wilting responded to the complaints saying that they were "just getting started".The Otera B1B was the first update to the Sorcerer's blueprints, increasing its size slightly, making the gunner seat more spacious and adding a second light Cirus GMAT Autocoil to the gunner's turret. No other changes were made.The Otera-B1C came one year later after the B1B and upgraded the two engines propelling the vehicle. Other changes to the airframe included wing-mounted proximity sensors and the addition of extra reinforcements to the cockpit area. The Otera-B1D came shortly afterwards, improving the reaction control system thrusters.
The Otera-B1E, released in 1789, made the first change to the payload capabilities of the Sorcerer. Two additional B/R-C2 hardpoints were added to the wingtips and the centreline fuselage hardpoints were upgraded to B-C4 class. The B1F configuration of the model repositioned the hardpoints for optimised roll torque stability when flying with an asymmetrical loadout. In 1850, a modernisation program called the Otera-B1FM Sorcerer was introduced by SCI for the the existing Otera-B1D, B1E and B1F units. Any B1C and earlier models could not support the changes.

item.title: Military
item.description:
A military is typically a group of combat-trained troops encompassing either a star fleet, an air force, a navy, an army, a defence force, or a combination of the five. Militaries are each made up of a set of ranks that define the troop hierarchy, usually extending from a small group of top leaders down to conscripts and/or recruits. They are equipped with technology - vehicles, weaponry and gear - from various companies, often receiving them on a long-term contract.
Each governmental body in the galaxy that oversees its own territory will often have a military of its own. These militaries answer to the government leaders themselves, especially if there is a war cabinet in office. The Kolban Alliance, civilisation governments and larger or more wealthy systems fund their own military forces. In less wealthy star systems and planets, militaries may not be financially viable, so security forces are hired instead. These forces often have to remain privately funded and as such commonly run with less modern equipment.Private militaries owned by wealthy businesses and even wealthier individuals are not uncommon. They are less organised than that of a running government but remain very powerful when commanded by an adequate leader and equipped with up-to-standard weaponry. However, they do remain monitored by the government to ensure the safety and legitimacy of the organisation.Although they are not officially considered militaries, stronger crime syndicates will often have powerful or dangerous groups of mercenaries on their side, usually purchased with large amounts of money on contract.

item.title: Mejir, Eppimos
item.description:
Infobox Eppimos Mejir was one of the co-founders of Mejir & Cron, the major Dottian infantry equipment manufacturer based on his founding partner’s home planet Plavv. Mejir is the one mostly credited with handling the business itself, rather than the actual weapons themselves.

item.title: Match, Yulo
item.description:
Infobox Yulo Match is best known for his work in founding the well-regarded Matchik Technologies, an advanced munitions manufacturing company. However, another of his considerable feats was his performance as both an athlete and engineer for the Dottians. Initially pursuing a career in Dottian competitive piloting, Match achieved bronze at the 1950 Galactic Games. However, his career was ended early when in 1952 he suffered a permanent leg in a starship collision above the planet of Fortheart. No longer able to compete in the games, Match took his interests and technical knowledge to university once again to study engineering. Upon making friends with Gabriel Rettik, Matchik Technologies was founded.

item.title: Language
item.description:
A vast range of languages exist in the galaxy, from Common, to Hagurr, to local languages such as Nestrikian. Language is often a core part of a culture, as it is generally what is used to pass down information and stories from generation to generation.
General Information

item.title: Kolban Pact
item.description:
Infobox The Kolban Pact is a treaty signed during the year 1712 after the events of the long-winded Cosmian Wars. It outlined many terms regarding the equality of the recognised races and the orders of society. The main item presented to the parties involved in the signing of the pact was the creation of the Kolban Alliance, a coalition designed to maintain peace amongst the space-faring civilisations for as long as possible. The pact itself was named after the planet Kolban, in the Jolloy system, where the treaty was signed.
Despite some initial disagreements on several terms of the treaty, all parties eventually agreed to the terms. The first signing was performed by the Sleethier representatives and occurred on the 1st of December. The pact's final signing was performed by the Dottian and Wythin representatives and occurred seven days later on the 8th of December, 1712. The Kolban Pact was established and enacted on the 25th of December and remains in existence to the present day.
The Kolban Pact formally recognised several different races and their civilisations. It also allows for additions to be made in the future, although this is still yet to happen. Once per decade, usually on the first year, the pact is passed by the leaders of each civilisation to verify the upholding of its terms. It is first held by the Linc, then sent to the Dottians, the Grandusks, the Myriads, the Cindii, the Sleethiers, the Xanfer and finally the Humans. Due to their largely uninvolved nature and uncaring stance, the Wythins are not sent the pact.
Cosmian Wars

item.description:
Infobox Saber “Fate” Herring founded the armour manufacturing company Red Herrings on the planet of Fortheart after studying medical science and engineering at university. item.title: Frank's Fission and Fusion
item.description:
Infobox Frank’s Fission and Fusion (also known as FFF or Triple F) is the leading company in power production, utilising multiple methods in order to produce sustainable energy which are then sold to planets, militaries and governments in bulk. The company constructs and maintains simple fission reactors on less wealthy planets that cannot afford energy by fusion, while doing the same with combined nuclear reactors that make use of both fission and fusion on the more wealthy planets. Although their ability to maintain fusion reactions for an extended period of time remains small as a result of technical limitations, it is enough for them to efficiently keep cities running. Frank’s Fission and Fusion also often operates with its sister company, Harry’s Heatworks, founded by Frank Smith brother Harry.
As the Cosmian Wars intensified, there was a surge in the requirement of energy production. Several parties involved in the wars turned to FFF and requested long-term supply deals, most of which were accepted and finalised. This popularity never fully wore off, making the energy supplier one of the wealthiest and most recognised companies in the galaxy.

item.title: Fauna
item.description:
Fauna refers to the various animals scattered throughout the galaxy. The majority of the animal kingdom has been evolving for millions of years, through processes such as genetic variation, natural selection and mutations. With the introduction of intelligent races, however, the influence on evolution within many species from external factors has become significant.
The primary factor affecting the development of animals is pollution. Major industrialisation of planets and systems as a whole has impacted animals' habitats, diets and thus lives. Deforestation and construction projects interfere with local habitats. Some groups advocate for the overall consideration of these effects in plans for engineering projects, especially when carrying them out on previously untouched environments.

item.description:
Infobox The Carrier Transport - 10 Bluebird carrier is a versatile high-speed, all-altitude atmospheric transport aircraft designed for carrying and delivering infantry to any location on a planet. Inflatable canvas sections position around the bottom edges of the fuselage provide a soft and smooth landing without the need for landing gear while also allowing the aircraft to quickly take off again.

item.description:
Infobox Aot Cron was one of the co-founders of Mejir & Cron, the major infantry equipment manufacturer based on his home planet Plavv. Noted as a very intelligent Dottian by many, he attended tertiary education at a prestigious institution. Cron is the one credited with most of the designs first released by M&C.

item.title: Bleak Enterprise
item.description:
Infobox Bleak Enterprise entered business in 1619, 24 years before the start of the Cosmian Wars. Richard Bleak was a highly ambitious man, immediately seeking to maximise both his company’s profits and its popularity. As a manufacturer of starships, orbital structures and ammunition, Bleak Enterprise benefited greatly from inter-racial conflicts where traveling and fighting between planets and star systems was key. At the time, a period of uncertain peace had settled over the galaxy. Behind the scenes, Bleak looked to spur on the different civilisations to generate additional business opportunities. Upon striking a deal with the members of Supreme Function, he began contributing towards the beginning of the newest and most destructive war in history.

item.title: Air
item.description:
Airborne vehicles are the main atmospheric vehicular technology used by all races. They exploit the air density of a planet to generate and maintain a certain amount of lift, that if greater than the planet's gravitational force, allows them to fly. Aircraft are most commonly used as an intermediary military force between ground units and exoatmospheric structures and vehicles, being capable of performing both ground strikes and launching weapons or other technology into orbit. The majority of aircraft are usually designed to fit a specific range of atmospheric pressures and air densities in order to allow them flight in the planets where they are needed most. However, this specific range can be modified for individual units if needed. The current leading aircraft manufacturers include Sideways Collective Industries and Wilde Manufacturing Co..

item.description:
Infobox Founded very early on in the Wythins’ journey into their system by pioneer Aerin Assimilis, Aerolite Mining Corps (commonly shortened to AMC) focuses almost entirely on mining their namesake resource: aerolite, a widely used low-density metal alloy, applied in many Wythin inventions. It was founded shortly before its sister company AeroTech. With their headquarters based on the planet Aezlothe, AMC remains a Wythin-owned company after over 14 centuries of operation.

item.title: Aerolite
item.description:
Infobox Aerolite is a rare metal alloy seemingly only found on the planet Windra in the Aeroth system. It is universally identified as a unique and valuable material due to its incredibly low average density of around 0.5 grams per cm^3. However, its primary interest is its relative strength. Despite mostly containing air, aerolite possesses more than three times the strength of common industry-standard steel. This makes it a highly sought after material, with even just a gram of it fetching hundreds of galactic tekks.
The existence of aerolite as a common resource in the Wythins' astral territory could hypothetically earn them a similar income to one of the more powerful Kolban Alliance civilisations, such as the Cindii. This is yet to happen though, as the majority of it is utilised in their civil engineering projects.
Aerolite is used for a wide range of applications, owing to the diversity of industries in which such a light but durable alloy is strived for. Some of these industries include starship, aircraft and armour manufacturing as well as in fire control systems. The material itself is generally mined and provided by the locally-run company Aerolite Mining Corps, before being refined and used by Aerotech, its sister corporation.

item.title: Rosten Company
item.description:
Infobox The Rosten Company is the largest retailer company in the galaxy, selling a wide range of general items such as clothing, accessories and tools. Originally starting out as an individual trading hub during the Cosmian Wars, managed by Derrick Rosten, the company was handed down to his son Milo after his death in 1690. Milo Rosten then expanded the company's reach until the Cosmian Wars ended, when he set up Rosten Company to begin retailing.
According to company and survey estimates, the Rosten Company employs well over 100,000,000 team members, from individual workers to star system managers. Rosten stores are positioned in every corner of the galaxy, in both planetary cities and space stations. As of the 2170 galactic census, the Rosten Company is the greatest monopoly by annual income in the galaxy.

item.title: Otera-F1 Paradigm
item.description:
Infobox The Otera-Fighter 1 Paradigm is a single seat, twin engine, light fighter starfighter manufactured by Sideways Collective Industries. It was the first design in the Otera starfighter line. Designed by SCI co-founder Bill Wilting himself, the F1 was popular amongst pilots in the Human military. It featured an efficient energy system, a simple design and considerably cheap costs for its time. Future tweaks and improvements upon this original design made the Otera family considered to be one of the most iconic starship lines in history. The Otera-F1 currently holds the record for the greatest number of starfighter sales over the course of a century.
The Otera-F1A was the first complete design to come out of Wilting's blueprint works. Armed with a single light Cirus GMAT Autocoil, developed by Yandavich Cirus from Vice Development, the Paradigm packed a relatively strong punch for a ship of its size. It also came prepared with two B/R-C2 hardpoints, allowing it to carry some extra ordnance for surface or structure attacks if needed. Alongside its effective offensive armament came a high number of countermeasures, with a total of 30 packets ready to be deployed in battle.
One year after the F1A's release, when sales of the starship began to increase exponentially, a slightly upgraded F1B model began production. This rendition of the Paradigm made minor changes to the technology software and hardware aboard the vehicle in response to consumer feedback received. Of note was the fixing of a hardware bug that caused the onboard navigation computer to repeatedly crash when flying in relative proximity to a star.
Released in 1778, the Otera-F1C upgraded the existing two hardpoints to B/R/M-C2 class, adding support for space launched missiles while also adding one more on both sides. This greatly increased the Paradigm's potency in space-to-space combat. However, the starfighter was not fitted with a radar, limiting its missile usage to that of infrared tracking. Due to the Kolban Alliance's limited missile options, the F1C was only ever equipped with the SLAM-3 and SLAM-4 missiles.The Otera-F1D was released in 1787. It was the most significantly changed model of the Paradigm. Outer layers of armour were added to the external sections of the cockpit in order to help guarantee a safe ejection in the event of an emergency. The engines received a revision, increasing total thrust output to ensure this armour did not negatively affect the acceleration and manoeuvrability of the vehicle. A single B-C4 hardpoint was also added to the centreline of the fuselage. Cockpit controls were cleaned up, resulting in two multi-function displays rather than three as well as a slight reduction in the total number of control surfaces.
The Otera-F1E was released one year later and increased the total number of countermeasures to 90. After the F1F upgrade was cancelled close to release in 1793, the F1G's stabiliser upgrades replaced it, but only as a minor addition. All three models were commonly seen armed with the SLAM-6 infrared guided missile, which was released in the same year as the Otera-F1D.
The Otera-F1K was released in 1805 and was the Paradigm's final upgrade. The nose of the starfighter was retroactively fitted with a radar, giving it access to the SLAM-6R semi-active radar homing missile. However, many complained of it being far too late to do so, especially given that the Otera-F2 was already known to be in the works. All four wing hardpoints on the F1K were adjusted to become B/R/M-C3 standard while the centreline fuselage remained the same. This allowed it to carry a powerful combative armament of Unlike the Otera-B1 Sorcerer and its B1FM modernisation upgrade, the Paradigm was not returned to until 2172 with the release of the Otera-F1X Deiknunai for the 400th Otera line anniversary.
Starfighters

item.title: Technology
item.description:
The various civilisations within the Sci-Fi World are highly technologically developed societies, making use of several millennia of effort and gradual progress in order to explore and colonise the galaxy. All kinds of technology are designed and manufactured by a wide range of specialised organisations, sometimes on contract with these civilisations. Technologies, a general umbrella term, can include things of all types, from military starships and weaponry to common household items.

item.title: VSM-00
item.description:
Infobox The Vleil Starworks Miner-00 was a two seat, twin engine, light miner support ship designed and manufactured by Vleil Starworks for the Dottian government. It was the first known space-oriented mineral mining vehicle to be developed in the galaxy. Using relatively primitive space technology, the VSM-00 utilised a heavily rifled drill alongside a series of magnetised plates in order to extract and collect minerals. Production of the VSM-00 ceased upon the development of the VSM-01. No known models of the starship remain in existence today, although a replica is on display at the Dottian Museum of Technology.

item.title: Starships
item.description:
Starships are the primary mode of transport throughout the galaxy. First developed by the Dottians, they exist through the combination of the most advanced technology the various galactic civilisations have to offer. Starships are used for a wide variety of purposes and functions, from combat and industrial mining to commercial or private transport. There are several classes of starships fitted for these purposes, differentiated mainly by their sizes. The current leading starship manufacturer is Sideways Collective Industries, as part of the Symbiote Triangle.All starships feature a set of primary propulsion engines, supplying the vehicle with a considerable amount of forwards thrust when active. In order to turn and perform various manoeuvres in space's low gravity and frictionless environment, a series of reaction control system (RCS) thrusters are positioned around the starship's frame. These thrusters usually utilise monomethylhydrazine as fuel and dinitrogen tetroxide as an oxidiser, although other combinations of substances have been successfully implemented. For more precise movements and adjustments, some starships are fitted with control moment gyroscope (CMG) systems or even reaction wheels.

item.title: FIRE-C-EX5
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives C-EX5 grenade is a rare, experimental anti-infantry incendiary grenade being designed by Topman Dynamics based on the FIRE-A4. It makes use of a different fractal pattern to any of the previous FIRE grenades and its effective radius could be adjusted alongside the fuse time.
Further development was hampered by various technical issues related to the aging FIRE platform and was eventually discontinued after funding was cut by the Fox Corporation in favour of searching for other, more modern incendiary platforms. Although the grenade was only privately released to shareholders in batches, some can occasionally be found in small sections of the galaxy.

item.title: ST-Slender
item.description:
Infobox The SharpTack-Slender is a long-established knife designed by the melee weapons manufacturer SharpTack. It is a lightweight survival knife favoured for its good grip and small size. Despite having first been designed almost an entire millennia ago, the Slender's basic but robust design has allowed it to remain in use by millions throughout the galaxy.
Melee Weaponry

item.title: Z1
item.description:
Infobox The Fox Corporation Z1 was one of the Fox Corporation's first custom minicoil designs. It was designed for general use in a vast range of situations. Lightweight and portable with its small amount of IW(Z) bullets, the Z1 was used widely as a sidearm in security forces across the galaxy. As a result of its cheap and small framing, the Z1 suffered some issues with durability, often wearing out its barrel and other smaller parts. This meant that while it performed excellently when new, its reliability began to dwindle as it got older. This original Z1 design has been further developed since, becoming the first in the well known series of general use minicoils.
Sidearms

item.title: SLAM-4
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 4 was a rear-aspect infrared combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during starship to starship engagements. The missile was the first to utilise ITAS, with the first being the Missile Automatic Kill Switch (MAKS), a safety feature designed to self destruct the missile if it loses track of its target for too long, implemented after pilots experienced spontaneous target-switching issues with the SLAM-3. This prevents it from eventually becoming a potential explosive hazard in the future or in crowded areas. The SLAM-4 also increased the seeker's flare resistance, making it slightly less susceptible to countermeasures deployed by the target.
With the introduction of the SLAM-4 to Kolban Alliance starfighters in 1745, the ratio of confirmed kills to losses for the starfighter fleet dramatically increased. With this, space-capable guided missiles quickly became much more commonplace in combat situations in the galaxy.
Missiles

item.title: SLAM-6R
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 6 Radar was a front-aspect semi-active radar homing combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during starship to starship engagements. Slow accelerating but very long ranged, the SLAM-6R was a breakthrough in terms of long range space engagements. It performed much better on average than its radar predecessor, the SLAM-5, but its high mass meant it was less suited for starfighters in large numbers. Upon its introduction to fleets across the galaxy, starship combat missiles began to be seen on warships in large quantities as well.

item.title: Artillery
item.description:
Artillery is the primary mode of ground-based heavy direct and indirect fire used by militaries throughout the galaxy. It is most commonly used to provide fire support and cover for advancing or retreating troops and vehicles from afar. Artillery units can either be stationary or mobile, depending on the requirements of their mission. Crews will usually utilise a range of technology to assist with scouting, targeting, ranging and firing upon targets from up to several hundred kilometres away.

item.title: Farracchi
item.description:
Infobox The Mansteid Farracchi is a civilian car designed and mass produced by Mansteid Auto beginning in 1985. It is one of the most purchased land vehicles in the galaxy by number of individual sales. There have been a number of models released to the public, as well as some exclusive models sold to specific individuals. Despite the original design being almost two centuries old and not having introduced any new technology since, the car remains popular with consumers to the present day.The 1985 Mansteid Farracchi was the first Farracchi model released to the public and sold in already record numbers believed to have been a result of the famous "Fabo Farracchi" advertisement campaign. Over twenty thousand units were purchased in its first two months of being available, coming close to breaking the record of around thirty thousand. The car was originally available in black, white, silver, red and blue. This range was temporarily expanded to include orange and green, but these were removed four months later.Mansteid Auto released a second model of the Farracchi alongside their more classic cars for the turn of the new millennium. It introduced various additional systems, such as a redesigned digital interface and improved atmospheric conditioning. Although it didn't sell nearly as many units as the original 1985 Farracchi, the 2000 model experienced a much more stable long-term rate of sales.At the beginning of the 22nd century, a new Farracchi was released alongside a six seater variant. The new 2100 model came with a slightly altered shape allowing for the addition of optional reclining positions. Some safety concerns were raised over these new chair designs but consumers were reassured that the seats were relatively safe. Statistical models have shown that although Farracchi-related deaths have not increased by any considerable amount, the number related to the reclining seats have.
Since its original model, many exclusive Farracchi models have been privately purchased by individuals, including one deal of a "streamlined" Farracchi between Mansteid Auto and Matchik Technologies co-founder Gabriel Rettik. In 1990, a Farracchi was fitted with rocket propulsion engines and a full atmospheric seal by the company before being launched into space and piloted manually.
A number of Farracchis have been customised with various additions or changes over the years since its release. In 2003, the Grandusk military retrofitted a Farracchi with an active weapons system, mounting an otherwise unused MC3C Zircon on the roof of the car as part of a media campaign.

item.title: FIRE-A1
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives A1 grenade is an anti-infantry incendiary grenade designed by Topman Dynamics. The model made use of a newly developed highly flammable liquid composition to rapidly spread fire across a small radius. This composition would be spread in a close-to-fractal pattern around the grenade, before being set alight a fraction of a second later. Manufactured and sold by the Fox Corporation, it quickly proved popular with mercenaries across the galaxy, despite the use of incendiary weapons in an anti-infantry role being frowned upon in some systems.

item.description:
Infobox Milo Rosten was the second CEO of the Rosten Company, one of the largest retail companies in the galaxy, for more than 60 years. He inherited the small business from his father Derrick Rosten at the young age of 19 and managed to transform it into a massively successful one. Infobox Winta Shelldau co-founded the well-regarded Topman Dynamics with her partner Playce Maestro. item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

This lost him favourability in the midst of the wars and, combined with its already falling popularity, the company’s profits fell under. item.description:

At the forefront of technological advancement, much of their work is performed behind the scenes covered by strict non-disclosure classifications. The company under the lead of Sudo Yagachi initially developed electronics for Human medical systems in the psychological and physiological departments, then switched to a broader plan after two decades. item.description:

Founded relatively recently by Becca Borfrice, the company was quick to build a solid consumer base in both the public and private medical industries.Recent announcements from Borfrice Bionics have revealed their intentions to expand their business beyond the medical sector, moving into general application of bionic engineering and implantation. As animals die from pollution and other artificially introduced factors, the plants that rely on them also struggle to survive. Mass harvesting of materials comes directly from the exploitation of these plants as well, leaving behind uninhabitable environments in their place. Recent new guidelines imposed by the Kolban Alliance are contributing to the effort to reduce these effects of external influence, so that these natural ecosystems can continue to function. item.title: Kolban Alliance
item.description:
The Kolban Alliance is a universal multi-racial alliance between all of the Kolban-recognised civilisations. Formed after the official signing of the Kolban Pact, the alliance maintains order in the centre of the galactic territories by regulating political and/or business activity and providing security or military assistance when appropriately requested. The Kolban Alliance maintains a consistently neutral political standing in order to remain as unbiased as possible.
Within the next few years after its creation, the Kolban Alliance established several universal systems, including but not limited to political and governmental systems, currency, security and even a common language. Most of these changes were made to further solidify the unification of the many civilisations that had been recognised by the Kolban Pact. Although there was backlash directed at some of them from a wide variety of members of each of the social classes, almost all of the originally proposed changes were passed and put in place.
The Kolban Alliance, being led by a diverse council based on a democratic governmental system, was immediately tasked with appropriately establishing a working political system that would systematically support as many people as possible. It was ultimately settled that the Alliance would operate on a political and governmental hierarchy. This system remains in place to this day, with the diverse Kolban Council overseeing all of the territories as a whole.
Before and during the Cosmian Wars, civilisations' currency systems were unique to one another, and conversion between them was a lengthy process. Early Kolban leaders sought to unify the universalise the currencies to allow for easier inter-civil trade. Most of the preceding currencies made use of both a main value and a secondary value (such as the Human dollar and cent) and every recognised civilisation operated with the decimal numeral system. This made it convenient to carry these attributes forward into the new currency, which ultimately became galactic tekks and drons.
A significant problem faced by the newly founded Kolban Alliance was that of security. Despite being a conglomerate of several civilisations, the Alliance itself did not initially have a particularly large military force. This meant that in the first few years piracy and other crime grew partially out of control. Part of the governing body's solution to this issue was to "borrow" personnel and equipment from the militaries of the larger civilisations - namely the Human, Sleethier and Dottian militaries. Over time, as funding increased, the military strength of the Kolban Alliance increased as well and security became less of an immediate issue.
The formation of the Kolban Alliance also brought to life a new language, that due the nature of its use, was called "Common". According to official figures, it took linguists several decades to configure the basis of the language and its vocabulary. Based off of a mix of the Human language English and several other dialects from the other mainstream languages, Common is now used throughout the galaxy by every civilisation and is by far the most widely spoken tongue.

item.title: Coilguns
item.description:
Coilguns are the general standard for basic ranged weapons in the galaxy. Introduced by then-leading development company Lance Innovations in 887 CE, they are the most common type of ranged infantry weapon in the galaxy. Coilguns operate by propelling a ferromagnetic projectile (a bullet) out of a tube containing a series of solenoids at extremely high speeds, by using the magnetic fields generated by this array of electromagnetic coils as propulsive mechanisms. Two shells (called the Internal and External shells) encase this system, for insulation and durability purposes. This combination of existing technology allows for coilguns to be used as primary arms or secondary arms in almost any environment, including in space, which is their key reason for mainstream use.
The coilgun manufacturing industry is one of the greatest and most lucrative. Constant conflict in various territories mean a constant supply of reliable weaponry is required. This has attracted companies of many forms to also invest in both the purchasing and production of the most modern coilgun technology.
There is a vast variety of different coilguns and bullets that allow for use in varying applications. Infantry coilguns are designed to be portable, accessible and, most of all, safe for the user. More conventional coilguns contain a simple electric circuit consisting of various solenoids and systems used to maximise efficiency and potency of the projectile emitted. Some more modern designs also introduce other coilgun integrated systems to assist the user themself.Most non-infantry coilgun designs come with light, medium, heavy and occasionally superheavy variants, offering a range of performances. Light designs tend to be less effective against strong armour but offer increased performance in other areas. Heavy designs provide stronger destructive and armour piercing capabilities at the cost of other aspects such as fire rate and accuracy. Superheavy designs amp this up further, for maximum destructive capabilities but generally perform similarly to light artillery with slow fire rates. Medium designs offer more balanced performance in most aspects.Different coilguns have different purposes and intended functions, meaning it can be hard to appropriately rate their performance in the field. As such, they are not rated by comparison against each other, but rather through testing on how well they fulfil their intended job. Some common variable properties of a coilgun include, but are not limited to the RPS, muzzle velocity, size and ammunition capacity. The latter two aforementioned properties are self-defining, but RPS and muzzle velocity are less understood by the public.The RPS (Rounds Per Second) of a coilgun refers to its fire rate. As the acronym suggests, it is a measure of how many continuous, consecutive rounds the coilgun can fire in any given second, not including possible reload times. For example, a coilgun with an RPS of 20 will fire 20 bullets in one second, or one bullet every 0.05 seconds. Since this number does not include possible reload times, if the coilgun had a magazine size of 5 bullets, it would take 0.25 seconds to empty it.The muzzle velocity, like conventional guns, refers to the relative speed of the projectile as it exits the barrel (or muzzle) of the coilgun. The magnitude of this property can depend on several factors, such as the mass of the projectile, the power rating of the coilgun and the total length of the barrel. Depending on the intended purpose of the coilgun itself, it may be more important for this value to be higher or lower.

item.description:
Infobox The Fox Corporation Z3 was a welcome upgrade and revival of the favoured minicoils produced by the Fox Corporation. It came with an increased clip capacity of 15 IW(Z) bullets and also managed the same fire rate of the previous Z2 despite not being based off it - the production base having been credited to the original Z1. item.title: T-Ten
item.description:
Infobox The Terrina-Ten is a small minicoil pistol independently designed by Fuhrr Terrina for use as a civilian self-defense sidearm. During her career, a spike in Kolban Alliance K-LIEU on-duty investigator deaths prompted Terrina to begin designing a civilian self-defense weapon - small enough to fit in the pocket holster, but large enough to still comply with civilian arms laws. The final product proved popular in systems where civilian gun ownership was legal and was even utilised by some military organisations. The newer T-Ten-L is still produced to this day.A version of the T-Ten with increased size in order to increase the accessibility of the weapon in systems where the concealed weapon size cap is higher. Although it did not increase the projectile capacity, the barrel and other proportions were upsized, providing some additional performance benefits. It was released in 2059.
Over the years of its operation, the T-Ten has been the target of some controversies regarding illegal civilian use of firearms in various systems. Debate began when Human Drew Lamotta used the weapon to shoot three others, including one K-ALEC guard, who survived and testified in court about the coilgun's apparent concealment in the suspect's pocket. Although the T-Ten itself was never banned from use, the situation also prompted conversation about other similar types of weapons to begin.

item.description:
Infobox The Fox Corporation Z2 was the Fox Corporation's first development upon the popular original Z1 design. It featured a slightly increased fire rate and a much needed improvement to frame durability. Although only a relatively minute adjustment to the Z1, especially considering the time passed since its release, the Z2 was well received and purchased in large quantities. Despite this, it was not used as the base platform for the development of the Z3 minicoil.

item.description:

Often referred to as "secondary weapons", sidearms are an optional piece of infantry equipment, but still see plenty of action in battle. They are often coilguns that are designed to be smaller and lighter than the majority of primary arms, but that retain their usefulness when lacking other options or in closed areas. As such, it is not uncommon to possess a sidearm for the purpose of self-defence, or even as a backup weapon. Advancing technology has also seen some primary weapons be miniaturised into secondary weapons while retaining their original effectiveness.

Infobox Fuhrr Terrina was a ballistics expert working for the Kolban Alliance, who became well known for independently designing the T-Ten minicoil in collaboration with the Fox Corporation. item.title: SLAM-9
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 9 was an all-aspect infrared combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during starship to starship engagements. It was the final infrared guided missile of the SLAM series to reach the mass production stage, before Kolban Alliance funding was ultimately turned to Sideways Collective Industries' long-competing DISC series, which was about to be picked up by the new Matchik Technologies company.
The SLAM-9 was not designed based on the close-range oriented SLAM-8, as is the common misconception. It instead originated from the SLAM-7 - having the new modern technology gradually incorporated into it. Despite this, the fact that almost every onboard system had been upgraded in some way meant the missile itself had essentially been redesigned from the ground up. The motor received a complete overhaul, with 9 seconds of forwards thrust time (3 seconds of which are saved for use later in flight) and 28,000 Newtons of thrust force.
The primary upgrade, however, came to the missile's seeker. Able to detect targets from up to 15 kilometres away, the SLAM-9 became by far the longest ranged space-launched infrared missile to date. In addition to the ITAS featured on the SLAM-8, the SLAM-9 introduced Close-In Final Guidance and Target Kill Proximity Angling, two systems increasing the missile's probability of kill by a considerable amount. In order to fully support them, its relative manoeuvrability was increased to 45 Gs. The missile became the base platform for the SLAM-9R.
Missiles

item.title: SLAM-8
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 8 was an all-aspect infrared combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during close range starship to starship engagements. The missile was modelled based on recently collected data regarding the performance of SLAM missiles (particularly the SLAM-7) and the pilots that used them. It had been found that a number of pilots struggled to accurately use the infrared guided missiles at short ranges (6 km or closer) to destroy enemy starfighters.In order to tackle this issue, the SLAM-8 was designed with short range performance in mind, featuring a very high rate of acceleration, 40 Gs of relative manoeuvrability, MFTP and even thrust vector control (TVC) in order to enhance its ability to hit close targets. This was boosted by the addition of infrared counter-countermeasures (IRCCM), with which the missile decreases its seeker's field of view over time. To complete its performance, the SLAM-8 was also fitted with a Zero Time Angling (ZTA) system, to allow it to accurately aim itself before activating its motor and beginning acceleration.
Missiles

item.title: SLAM-7
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 7 was a limited all-aspect infrared combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during starship to starship engagements. This particular upgrade was intended to make the SLAM family even more accurate than the SLAM-6 had been, with a very high relative manoeuvrability and the introduction of Mid-Flight Thrust Pausing, allowing the missile to save additional fuel for its final lineup toward the target. Tested with and without MFTP, it was found that having the ITAS available increased the chances of a clean kill in controlled test environments by as high as 20%.
Missiles

item.title: Missiles
item.description:
Missiles are guided, self-propelled munitions that will track a target and guide themselves on an interception path to said target, before detonating a warhead. There are a multitude of different types of missiles for different purposes, such as tracking and destroying starships. Due to their highly mobile nature, they are most commonly equipped on combat aircraft, starfighters, warships, combat vehicles and stationary silos.Integrated Tracking Assistive Systems are built-in modifications to the tracking and interception logic of a missile. They each affect an aspect of the missile's behaviour, allowing it to more effectively make "decisions" in different scenarios and environments - thus increasing the probability of a kill. These ITAS can work in accordance with one another, multiplying the missile's efficiency. Given their nature, most ITAS are only utilised on space launched missiles.General ITASInfrared ITASSemi-Active Radar Homing ITASActive Radar Homing ITAS

item.title: SLAM-9R
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 9 Radar was an all-aspect active radar homing combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during long range starship to starship engagements. Derived from the SLAM-9 platform, the infrared seeker was swapped out for a miniaturised mechanical radar and more fuel was added. This made the missile very heavy and less manoeuvrable, but greatly increased its range, allowing use in many different situations. Although it was powerful and could be used on both starfighters and warships, the slow development of the SLAM family as a whole meant it had already been surpassed by Sideways Collective Industries' DISC series of missiles and the Fox Corporation was unable to reacquire the Kolban Alliance contract.
Missiles

item.title: SLAM-5
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 5 was a front-aspect semi-active radar homing combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during starship to starship engagements. Based on the SLAM-4 infrared guided missile platform, the SLAM-5 featured a much longer burn time, lasting seven seconds instead of the previous four and a longer guidance thrust time. These upgrades allowed the SLAM-5 to propel itself almost three times as far, giving it an unparalleled range for its time.
However, the SLAM-5 was not without issues. Its SARH search cone could only reliably cover up to around 12 kilometres of the 19 kilometre range at frontal aspect, limiting its ability to make full use of its primary strengths. The radar also had very little resistance against chaff, meaning the missile was very easily defeated by targets with countermeasures. Its relative agility also took a hit, the missile only being able to pull a relative 15 Gs. These problems meant that even well trained military pilots would most often only launch the SLAM-5 at ranges under 6 kilometres.
Missiles

item.title: SLAM-3
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 3 was a basic rear-aspect infrared combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during starship to starship engagements. It was the first space launched missile to begin being regularly seen in combat. Coming from the SLAM-1 and SLAM-2, two missiles equipped with fully caged seekers, the most significant upgrade to the SLAM-3 was the newly designed uncaged seeker, allowing the missile to "look" in different directions off its centre. With another new motor and a small increase to relative agility, the Fox Corporation proved that space launched missiles could eventually become the new norm for space combat.
An series of friendly-fire incidents involving the SLAM-3 losing track of their targets and instead locking onto unintended heat signatures prompted the SLAM family design team to begin the design of the first ITAS, the Missile Automatic Kill Switch. This was later implemented onto the SLAM-4.
Missiles

item.title: SLAM-2
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 2 was a basic rear-aspect infrared combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during starship to starship engagements. Developed off of the SLAM-1 with newfound funding, the -2 variant featured an upgraded motor, improved agility from reprogrammed reaction control system thrusters and more guidance thrust time - an all around improvement over the former.
Missiles

item.title: SLAM-1
item.description:
Infobox The Space Launched Assault Missile - 1 was a basic rear-aspect infrared combat missile designed by the Fox Corporation for use in space during close range starship to starship combat. Released just after the Cosmian Wars ended, the SLAM-1's design team lacked proper funding to promote the the weapon to manufacturing stage due to the sudden lack of the need for space combat weapons. However, as conflicts began increasing in number again in smaller combat arenas, the SLAM-1 served as the basis for future missiles in the SLAM family, such as the SLAM-2.
Missiles

item.title: Otera-B1FM Sorcerer
item.description:
Infobox The Otera-Bomber 1F Modernised Sorcerer is a twin-engine, light bomber starfighter designed and manufactured by Sideways Collective Industries as part of the mass modernisation program for the original and ageing Otera squadrons part of the Human star fleet. Any existing Otera-B1D or later models were converted by their respective owners.
An overall redesign of the main fuselage section moved the rear-mounted Cirus GMAT Autocoils to the front of the starship, removing the need for a gunner as a third crew member. The inner B-C3 hardpoints were upgraded to B-C4 capability while the outer B-C2 hardpoints were deemed unnecessary and changed to M-CX class, allowing the Sorcerer access to two SLAM-7 infrared guided space launched missiles as part of its loadout. As a result of the fuselage redesign, extra countermeasure pods were added to the rear of the vehicle, increasing maximum countermeasure capacity to 600.The engines and reaction control system thrusters did not receive any changes, however. Despite receiving feedback requesting additional manoeuvrability, SCI stated that due to the minimal change in overall structural mass, there was no incentive to make changes to the propulsion systems without further complexifying the fuselage arrangement.
Starfighters

item.title: Red Herrings
item.description:
Infobox Red Herrings is a manufacturing company that specialises in the development and production of individual armour and other protective gear. The small startup almost failed to financially progress during its first two years after an internal cyber attack lost it several hundreds of thousands of tekks' worth of value. However, it made a comeback after Saber Herring managed to garner the support and sponsorship of multiple well-known benefactors. In 2167, Red Herrings was officially contracted to begin manufacturing armour for the Kolban Alliance.
Organisations

item.title: Plurge Weapon Solutions
item.description:
Infobox Plurge Weapon Solutions is an infantry equipment manufacturing company founded by Grandusk billionaire Hrechi Plurge. Originally a trading company, the once Plurge Corporation changed its operations and name due to internal conflicts involving discussion about competition. It began manufacturing newly designed weapon technology and helped fuel conflicts behind the scenes under the cover of the ongoing Cosmian Wars to maximise profits. These plots have since been uncovered and the organisation was almost liquidated. The company known today claims to have appropriately reformed its practices. PWS has the second largest monopoly over infantry equipment development, only behind the Fox Corporation and competing with Mejir & Cron.
Organisations

item.title: Payne Explotech
item.description:
Infobox Payne Explotech is a research and development institution specialising in explosives and ammunition of all types. It is a much smaller company than others such as Topman Dynamics and Primus Manufacturing, but it is known for performing its work just as well. Founder Larry Payne was adamant on always collaborating on their projects and even after his death Payne Explotech has been seen working with various other organisations, including both competitors and industry leaders.
Organisations

item.title: Grenund Constructive
item.description:
Infobox Grenund Constructive is a major ground technology manufacturer, founded by the well known Cindus Stav Grenund. One of the largest Cindus-owned corporations, much of its workforce is made up of Cindii. Despite being active during the Cosmian Wars, Grenund Constructive had limited involvement in the procurement of weaponry and machines for the conflicts. Even so, the company’s positive financial status saw it survive the first few decades and kept it afloat amongst the rest as other establishments fell through. The organisation remains in operation to this day, still working primarily for the Cindus government.
Organisations

item.title: Rockets
item.description:
Rockets are unguided self-propelled explosive munitions typically used in large batches in order to increase accuracy. With the changing technology of modern development, the use of rockets is declining in favour of guided missiles and bombs. This process has been considerably accelerated by the introduction of swarm missiles.

item.title: Rettik, Gabriel
item.description:
Infobox Gabriel Rettik was a co-founder of Matchik Technologies, collaborating with his other Dottian friend Yulo Match in order to develop a manufacturing company surrounding their own personal and professional expertise. A well-studied and practiced engineer in the field, Rettik developed new missile guidance software and hardware for the company mostly by himself.
Organisations

item.title: LAC-1 Vulture
item.description:
Infobox The Wilde Manufacturing Co. Light Attack Craft 1 Vulture was a tandem two-seat, single engine, supersonic jet strike aircraft designed for direct ground target attack. Its main armament was the 20mm Glacis Rotary Cannon, positioned to the right of the nose. Despite its overall favourable performance in its primary role, the Vulture suffered from very poor low speed manoeuvrability and energy retention when turning, as well as a slow roll rate. This limited its ability to make quick getaways in the event of a counterattack.
The LAC-1A was the first model of the Vulture, packaged with all of its base features. Several hundred units were purchased by the Human and Sleethier militaries on release. It was used almost exclusively to make direct bombing runs on enemy-occupied locations and proved very successful in Suppression of Enemy Air Defence missions. However, it was highly prone to Surface-to-Air Missiles, and a large number were lost during these bombing runs.The LAC-1B was an experimental Vulture upgrade that never moved past prototype stage. It increased the aircraft's total wingspan and attempted to add more hardpoints further out, but it was found that this caused the structural integrity of to drop below acceptable levels.The LAC-1C was a converted model of the LAC-1A models, and expanded on the aircraft's available armament options. The aircraft was retrofitted with a basic pulse air intercept radar, as well as air-to-air missile capability on the outer hardpoints. Additional units were manufactured and purchased by the Sleethiers.The LAC-1D was a further upgraded model of the Vulture and introduced an additional two inner hardpoints, increasing the aircraft's maximum payload. The jet engine was also upgraded, increasing the total thrust generated and improving fuel efficiency. The LAC-1D was purchased in bulk by the Humans for use in their primary air assault force.
Combat Aircraft

item.title: Hardpoints
item.description:
Hardpoints are used in starships and planetary aerial vehicles to launch or drop ordnance for practical use. Different types of hardpoints are capable of carrying different types of ordnance. For example, a designation B/M-C2 hardpoint is capable of carrying bombs of up to explosive class 2 as well as any missiles of a similar size and mass. Traditionally, hardpoints are stored on the outside of the vehicle, but in recent decades modern aircraft and starships have begun to feature internal bays for weapons storage - allowing for more advanced radar stealth technology.
Hardpoints are separated based on their designations of HP#-C#. The first # refers to the type of hardpoint: B for Bomb, R for Rocket, T for Torpedo, M for Missile, C for Cruise Missile and X for any type. Slashes between types means it is variable between the listed types.The second # refers to the relative class of the hardpoint. The model of a hardpoint can affect its performance, such as release time and stability. Hardpoint classes also relate to the size classes of the ordnance released from them. For example, a bomb with a size class of 3 can only be dropped from a class 3 or lower bomb hardpoint. X class hardpoints can carry any size class of ordnance. Missiles do not use classes, so missile exclusive hardpoints remain as X class.
General Information

item.description:
Combat vehicles are the primary ground vehicle fighting force of military groups. They are typically armed with a main armament, such as a cannon or guided Missile launcher, and are specifically designed to destroy a particular type of target or assist another in doing so.
