item.title: Colbet, Plexi
item.description:
Infobox Plexi Colbet worked for Lance Innovations and was the patenter of the popular Colbet line of military revolvers. Remembered as an intelligent and hardworking woman by colleagues, Colbet also served two decades in the Human Star Fleet as a radar intercept officer.
People

item.title: Cirus, Yandavich
item.description:
Infobox Yandavich Cirus worked at Vice Development in the Weaponry Technologies Department. The Dottian is best known for his work as the patenter of the popular Cirus GMAT Autocoil vehicle armament platform, which was integrated into the even more popular Otera starfighter line made by Sideways Collective Industries.
People

item.title: Craset, Feshmer
item.description:
Infobox Feshmer Craset was a Dottian diplomat, serving from 1615 to her death in 1633. She was killed during the events of the Hitch Incident, thus becoming the second diplomat murdered and ultimately the final spark that set fire to the start of the Cosmian Wars.
People

item.title: Hitch, Zing
item.description:
Infobox Zing Hitch was a Linc diplomat, serving from 1617 to his death in 1633. He is infamous as the first diplomatic envoy killed in the Hitch Incident, named after him. Hitch was well respected in the Linc political scene, having once been a politician involved with major economic changes that boosted the Linc’s financial situation.
People

item.title: The Humanoid Group
item.description: Infobox This article is currently being developed and will be published soon. Organisations

item.title: Umbra Organisation
item.description:
Infobox The Umbra Organisation is a mercenary hiring company that specialises in working espionage. The group often sees work coming from the major leaders of civilisations and/or other companies. Members in the Umbra Organisation do not align themselves with individual persons or ideologies and thus claim to work in an unbiased manner. The actual legality of their work in the field is debatable. This article is still in-progress and will be finished soon.
Organisations

item.title: AeroTech
item.description:
Infobox AeroTech was founded by Aerin Assimilis at the same time as its mining counterpart, Aerolite Mining Corps. The two companies work hand-in-hand to supply the Wythin population with the latest Wythin tech, often made out of the valuable resource aerolite. AeroTech also sometimes works beyond the Aeroth system, collaborating with other nearby companies on special contracts.
Organisations

item.title: SA-FER PHMS
item.description:
Infobox The Simple Action - Full Electromagnetic and Radioactive Protective HazMat Suit is an all-in-one protective set of gear used by employees of Frank's Fission and Fusion and Harry's Heatworks when handling or around hazardous materials. The full containment of electrical equipment within the suit prevents it from being affected by external influences, allowing the wearer to perform testing and other work in almost any condition.
SA-FER is also outsourced to other companies and contractors working in the same or similar fields. In order to cover increasing manufacturing costs, the company is supposedly planning to also outsource production of the suit to Red Herrings.
Body Armour

item.title: Buckler-2E Frontal BDG
item.description:
Infobox The Buckler-2E Frontal Bomb Defusal Gear is Red Herrings' further development on the Buckler-1 design. It improves upon the armour's defensive capabilities while also optimising the positioning of components to allow for increased movement. These changes made the Buckler-2E far more popular than its predecessor, as well as some competing products. However, consumers felt negatively about the armour's cost, with its base sale price sitting around two times higher than the cheapest in the market.
Body Armour

item.title: FIRE-A4
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives A4 grenade is an anti-infantry incendiary grenade designed by Topman Dynamics and manufactured by the Fox Corporation. Branching from both the development of both the A3 and B3 models of FIRE incendiary grenades, the A4 is by far the most effective model, with a large effective range, adjustable fuse time and a new flammable liquid composition.
Explosives

item.title: TEMP-SR-20
item.description:
Infobox The Tactical Electromagnetic Pulse Short Range 20 is a small electromagnetic grenade manufactured by the Fox Corporation and developed by Topman Dynamics. It is the first descendant of the TEMP-SR-10, with its increased range and fuse time both inherited from the LEMP-SR-20, which had been created two years prior.
Explosives

item.title: TEMP-SR-10
item.description:
Infobox The Tactical Electromagnetic Pulse Short Range 10 is a small electromagnetic grenade manufactured by the Fox Corporation and developed by Topman Dynamics, based on its LEMP counterpart. The TEMP features an unshackled pulse strength, allowing the damage caused to be noticeably increased. However, the TEMP-SR-10 grenades are expensive and have been described by soldiers as being "delicate", meaning they do not see as much use as the safer and more reliable LEMP variants.
Explosives

item.title: G4d.F Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 4d Fragmentation Grenade was a fourth generation grenade designed by Lance Innovations during the Cosmian Wars based upon the favoured G4b.F Grenade. It was primarily developed in order to act upon the feedback from soldiers that the fuse time of the G4b.F could often end up dangerous to the thrower - and that it could be reliably increased without making it easier for the enemy to escape its effective radius. Lance Innovations increased the fuse time to 7.5 seconds, but also found reason to slightly upgrade the effective radius to 25 metres based on available data. However, the G4d.F was released too late to have a notable effect in battle, as the closing decades of the Cosmian Wars saw less infantry-to-infantry combat.
Explosives

item.title: G4.F Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 4 Fragmentation Grenade was an experimental fourth generation grenade conceptualised by Lance Innovations in response to the beginning of the Cosmian Wars. It was to include a dramatically increased effective range of 30 metres and a slightly longer fuse time of seven seconds, as well as a significantly greater average lethality. Despite never making it to full production, the prototype paved the way for the successful G4b.F Grenade. The G4.F model is occasionally available in the markets but is rare, expensive, and too unreliable for reasonable use, meaning it does not see as much action as the previous G3e.F design.
Explosives

item.title: G4b.F Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 4b Fragmentation Grenade was a fourth generation grenade designed by Lance Innovations during the Cosmian Wars based upon the unsuccessful G4.F Grenade. It saw a considerable amount of use throughout the 79 years of the wars, becoming one of the most used expendable weapons of the conflict. Compared to its prototype predecessor, the G4b.F had its effective radius reduced along with its fuse time, but had its potency within that range significantly increased. The resulting model was heavy but highly lethal. Some issues were encountered with the six second fuse time, with some arguing that it was simply too short, making the grenade equally as dangerous to the thrower. This feedback led to the development of the G4d.F Grenade.
Explosives

item.title: G3e.F Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 3e Fragmentation Grenade was designed by Lance Innovations in response to complaints of unreliable performance from the G2a.F and G2c.F grenades. To combat this, the effective radius was further increased, the fuse time was lowered to 4.5 seconds and the number of fragmental projectiles was doubled. The G3e.F remained one of the top fragmentation grenades in use throughout the next several decades, even remaining in production with the Fox Corporation to this day.
Explosives

item.title: G2c.F Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 2c Fragmentation Grenade was developed by Lance Innovations based on the previous G1.F Grenade, as an additional branch of the same family of weapons. It featured an almost doubled effective radius but maintained the five second fuse time. The G2c.F is still manufactured in small numbers by the Fox Corporation.
Explosives

item.title: G2a.F Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 2a Fragmentation Grenade was developed by Lance Innovations based on the previous G1.F Grenade designed 42 years earlier. It features a 14 metre effective radius and a one second shorter fuse time, to allow for more aggressive use in combat. The G2a.F is still manufactured in small numbers by the Fox Corporation.
Explosives

item.title: G1.Im Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 1 Impact Grenade was the first and only anti-infantry impact grenade designed by the team at Lance Innovations. Due to its nature as an impact grenade, the G1.Im was designed to have a low effective radius. Unlike some of their other grenade lines, it did not pick up much popularity and the line was never continued. It is still produced in small amounts by the Fox Corporation for select buyers but is otherwise rare and not necessarily very effective in battle.
Explosives

item.title: G1.Fb Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 1 Flashbang Grenade is an early flashbang designed by Lance Innovations and now manufactured by the Fox Corporation that disorients targets' senses upon detonation. Designed to cause confusion in those affected, the G1.Fb utilises bright light and very loud noise to render targets mostly blind for up to 15 seconds while also leaving them in a dazed state. The effectiveness of the flashbang relies on targets being close to the blast, with those well within the approximate effective radius generally having their retinas burned.
Explosives

item.title: G2.Fb Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 2 Flashbang Grenade is Lance Innovations' development upon the G1.Fb and one of the company's final releases. It harshly burns the eyes and can burst eardrums within a few metres of detonation. Also improving upon its predecessor's non-lethal effects, it can leave targets mostly blind and dazed for up to 20 seconds. The G2.Fb has since been replaced by superior designs, but as per policy is still manufactured by the Fox Corporation.
Explosives

item.title: FIRE-B3
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives B3 grenade is an anti-infantry incendiary grenade designed by Topman Dynamics and manufactured by the Fox Corporation. It introduced a much larger effective radius than the FIRE-B1 and B2, covering a total diameter of 60 metres. This was combined with the FIRE-A3's liquid composition and a variable time fuse, allowing the user to adjust the fuse time from a minimum of four seconds to a maximum of six. The resulting customisability and effectiveness in combat made the B3 a very popular incendiary grenade, despite the limited legality of the class.
Explosives

item.title: FIRE-A3
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives A3 grenade is an anti-infantry incendiary grenade designed by Topman Dynamics and manufactured by the Fox Corporation. Once again improving on the platform, the A3 proved to be more consistent and longer ranged than its predecessors, the FIRE-A2 and FIRE-A1. However, its main technological upgrade came with a refinement of the flammable liquid composition used, making it even more deadly.
Explosives

item.title: FIRE-B2
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives B2 grenade is an anti-infantry incendiary grenade designed by Topman Dynamics and manufactured by the Fox Corporation. Keeping in line with the FIRE-B1's original concept, the B2 features a relatively short four second fuse time while primarily increasing its effective radius.
Explosives

item.title: FIRE-B1
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives B1 grenade is an anti-infantry incendiary grenade designed by Topman Dynamics and manufactured by the Fox Corporation. Developed as a counterpart to the previous year's A1 model, the B1 was intended as a alternative variant with a shorter fuse time and slightly larger effective radius. During the later stages of its design however, a number of fixes for the various flaws encountered with the production FIRE-A1 were also implemented before final testing.
Explosives

item.title: FIRE-A2
item.description:
Infobox The Fractal Incendiary Ready Explosives A2 grenade is an anti-infantry incendiary grenade designed by Topman Dynamics and manufactured by the Fox Corporation. A slight upgrade from the FIRE-A1, the A2 has a greater effective radius and suffers from less frequent malfunctions.
Explosives

item.title: KJDT-1L Killjoy
item.description:
Infobox The Kinetic Joint Defence Turret - 1L "Killjoy" is an upgraded variant of autonomous turret produced by Matchik Technologies. It improves upon its predecessor, the KJDT-1H, by expanding its range of coilgun compatibility and improving its infrared imaging and targeting systems to heighten accuracy. Supporting wireless datalink infrastructure, the 1L is capable of using location and status information transmitted from compatible devices held by infantry operators or drones to differentiate between friendlies and enemies.
Deployables

item.title: KJDT-1H Killjoy
item.description:
Infobox The Kinetic Joint Defence Turret - 1H "Killjoy" is an autonomous turret defence system designed and manufactured by Matchik Technologies for use in both combat and extensive security operations. The main speciality of the KJDT-1 series is its interchangeable weapons systems, compatible with a selection of different coilguns. This allows it to switch out coilguns for different situations, or be completely disabled from combat by operators for safety purposes. The Killjoy does not support the use of unconventional modifications.
Due to its small size, the turret uses infrared imaging and a pre-programmed targeting system to identify possible targets, which bases its initial acquisition procedures on manually applied settings. However, this does not mean the Killjoy isn't prone to misfiring upon non-targets or even friendlies - a situation which occurred several times over its time in service. It was eventually replaced by a newer model, the 1L.
Deployables

item.title: AirShock M2R4
item.description:
Infobox The AirShock Model 2 Revision 4 (originally named VX-A7 in prototype stage) is a further developed model of the AirShock M1R2 weapon designed by Vice Development and manufactured by Plurge Weapon Solutions. The M2R4 was a considerable improvement over the previous versions in the AirShock family of weapons, thanks to its doubling down on both the long-running and more recent drawbacks of the series.No longer being forced to tolerate problems with durability and now having the capability to be used in a wider variety of atmospheric conditions, the AirShock M2R4 shows greatly increased performance over its predecessors and is still in use today. However, the recent release of the AirShock M3 has meant that consumers are beginning to replace these now-aging weapons.
Primary Arms

item.title: AirShock M1R2
item.description:
Infobox The AirShock Model 1 Revision 2 (originally named VX-A2 in prototype stage) is an upgraded version of the AirShock M1R1 weapon designed by Vice Development and manufactured by Plurge Weapon Solutions. The R2 revised standard features increased energy efficiency and improved weapon stabilisation. These changes allowed it to become much more reliable, although it still suffered from some significant issues, including a low durability and a heavy reliance on the operating conditions. Further development of the series branched from this variant.
Primary Arms

item.title: AirShock M1R1
item.description:
Infobox The AirShock Model 1 Revision 1 (originally named VX-A1 in prototype stage) is an unconventional infantry-based weapon designed by Vice Development and manufactured by Plurge Weapon Solutions that releases large amounts of controlled energy to create shockwaves of varying strength in the air around it. Due to its nature, the AirShock is to be used exclusively within atmospheric conditions and is unsuitable for use under extreme atmospheric pressures.
Several engineers working at Vice Development who were in charge of the design of the weapon have openly admitted that the M1R1 design is flawed and ultimately inefficient, but that they would continue to work on improving upon it, as it has “great potential”. This was achieved with the AirShock M1R2 and later the AirShock M2R4 models.
Primary Arms

item.title: G1.F Grenade
item.description:
Infobox The Generation 1 Fragmentation Grenade was developed by Lance Innovations as a baseline design for future anti-infantry grenades. It features a relatively small effective range of zero to ten metres as well as the now-standard five second fuse time. Despite now being easily outclassed by other more modern grenades, the G1.F - now manufactured by the Fox Corporation - is still widely used as a training model due to its low lethality at longer distances.
Explosives

item.title: Melee Weaponry
item.description:
Melee weaponry refers to handheld non-ranged weapons used in CQB (Close-Quarters Battle) by combatants. This technology can include items such as knives, hammers and kunai. Most melee weapons are small and lightweight, making them a standard part of infantry equipment loadouts for combatants. However, it is also the case that melee weapons are easily replaceable by almost any item able to be held in one's hands, meaning the melee technology produced by modern companies is specially designed for lethality.
PED-Ex ONE - An experimental knife developed by Harry's Heatworks that makes use of a temporary application of plasma
ST-Slender - A classic lightweight knife nearing its 1000th anniversary since its first design and manufacture by SharpTack
ST-Slender
ST-Zeal

item.title: ST-Zeal
item.description:
Infobox The ST-Zeal is a heavyweight survival knife mass produced by SharpTack. Similarly to the ST-Slender, the Zeal is one of the company's flagship products, selling more items than almost any other existing melee brand's products combined.
Melee Weaponry

item.title: SharpTack
item.description:
Infobox SharpTack, founded by Nivian Pergot, is one of the longest running companies to still be in operation today. This can be seen in its most popular products, such as the ST-Slender and ST-Zeal survival knives. Holding great power and influence within the melee weaponry market, the Xanfer organisation manufactures the majority of handheld melee weapons in stock today. Recently, SharpTack made the decision to absorb several other smaller manufacturers in the business, further solidifying its domination of the industry.
Organisations

item.title: Coilgun Integrated Systems
item.description:
Coilguns are a heavily modifiable group of weapons, allowing for various additional systems designed to assist the user when in combat. As such, many of them feature a range of Coilgun Integrated Systems (CIS) that carry out these tasks. The purposes of CIS can involve efficiency, safety and usability, among others. Most CIS are created so that they are compatible with the majority of coilguns, regardless of model or manufacturer. However, some are either built for use in just one type of coilgun or are made obsolete by technological developments in the future.Some CIS work with the purpose to make the coilgun itself more efficient, whether that be in power usage, cooling, rate of fire or other function. More modern approaches to the coilgun industry have fitted systems with automatic power return and energy callback integrations in order to automate the more focus-intensive tasks related to coilgun operation.Since the beginning of the 20th century, coilgun safety has become a larger talking point in various areas of the industry, primarily as a result of a rising number of lethal operational incidents. As a result, newer, more modern CIS have been developed to help constitute the continued general use of coilguns.A key aspect that is often pioneered to improvement is the usability of coilguns. Classic designs required the user to power up the coil system between each projectile shot and the exact controls for the different functions of the weapon were complicated and unclear. Newer coilgun models have allowed for single-trigger systems, much more similar to conventional guns.
General Information

item.title: AirShock M3
item.description:
Infobox The AirShock Model 3 (originally named VX-A10 in prototype stage) is a further developed model of the AirShock M2R4 and the unreleased AirShock M2R6, once again designed by Vice Development and manufactured by Plurge Weapon Solutions. Although based on two prior models of the AirShock series, the M3 was mostly built from scratch, only borrowing the frame of the M2R4 and the custom power unit of the M2R6. Highly effective in most situations, the AirShock M3 features enhanced safety features alongside noticeable increases in range and power output over the previous generations.
Primary Arms

item.title: Payne, Larry
item.description:
Infobox Larry Payne was the founder of Payne Explotech, a research and development company specialising in explosives. After obtaining a degree in explosives engineering, Payne set out to fill the existing gap in research within the explosives industry. The pioneering Human managed to do so but not after several struggles against competitors.
People

item.title: Potte, Jannis
item.description:
Infobox Jannis Potte was the founder of Primus Manufacturing, the munitions manufacturing company part of the Symbiote Triangle. She was a Human child prodigy from birth, achieving highly in every subject she studied. Taking after her father’s interests, Potte became involved in engineering, working at Topman Dynamics for 18 years before starting her own company.
People

item.title: Jurie, Theian
item.description:
Infobox Theian Jurie is the founder and current CEO of Prodigy Systems and a past employee of Sideways Collective Industries. An expert in starships with multiple engineering degrees, Jurie has gained the trust of many from tertiary education, past work and current. The Sleethier has recently announced she will be retiring from her position at the end of the decade, handing the title position down to a now more appropriate candidate.
People

item.title: Prodigy Systems
item.description:
Infobox Prodigy Systems is a starship research and development company based in the Sleethier astral territory. The founder Theian Jurie spent half a decade working at Sideways Collective Industries before leaving to design her own products. Her company has since found a good deal of success within the Sleethier borders and moderate success beyond.
Organisations

item.title: Mejir & Cron
item.description:
Infobox Mejir & Cron is a major infantry equipment manufacturing company that grew from the defeat of the Dottians after the Cosmian Wars. The only current manufacturer in its industry able to rival Plurge Weapon Solutions and even the Fox Corporation, M&C’s achievements are often overshadowed by its superiors. This does not mean its products are unpopular however, as its lines of unique weapons frequently find stable places within the market. The company's founders Eppimos Mejir and Aot Cron early on directed their attention toward the lack of competition within the infantry equipment industries. They later managed to monopolise on the domination from the Fox Corporation and Plurge Weapon Solutions, giving consumers a third reliable option to buy from.
Organisations

item.title: Smith, Harry
item.description:
Infobox Born on Plix of the Human territory and founder of Harry's Heatworks, Harry Smith was highly regarded for his contributions to modern technological advancements. The brother of Frank Smith, founder of Frank's Fission and Fusion, he specialised in plasma physics and thermodynamics. During the early years of the Cosmian Wars, he put his knowledge to use, developing systems to support and accommodate the growing use of energy and the fourth state of matter.
People

item.title: Yagachi, Sudo
item.description:
Infobox Sudo Yagachi was the founder of Yagachi Electric, the galactic electronics manufacturing company. Having worked with technology at all levels for most of his life, Sudo was aware of the need for new electronics in several medical systems throughout the Human astral territory. After having his designs accepted and funded for manufacturing by the system governments, he established his own company and began operating beyond the astral territory's borders.
People

item.title: Plurge, Hrechi
item.description:
Infobox Hrechi Plurge was a wealthy Grandusk businessman, the founder of the Plurge Corporation, now known as Plurge Weapon Solutions. He made clever use of the havoc the Cosmian Wars were making to secretly fuel other smaller wars to benefit off of them without much risk of being discovered. The Grandusk's past plots are no longer hidden from the public and they created waves in the news for several weeks after being revealed but his biggest creation, PWS, ultimately lives on.
People

item.title: Smith, Frank
item.description:
Infobox Born on Plix of the Human astral territory and founder of Frank's Fission and Fusion, Frank Smith was a pioneer of modern technology and power generation. The brother of Harry Smith, founder of Harry's Heatworks, he spearheaded the movement to invest more research into power generation through fusion after several breakthroughs had been made before the beginning of the Cosmian Wars. Historians state that Smith was one of the main key players in keeping fundamental and ethical science alive during the deadly conflict, despite growing in age.
People

item.title: Gerranne, Yun
item.description:
Infobox Yun Gerranne was the founder of the Gerranne Rotunda Project, a research organisation dedicated to the development and execution of her brainchild, the Gerranne Procedure. During her long life, she also worked for the Human government and various other Human agencies.
People

item.title: Harry's Heatworks
item.description:
Infobox Harry’s Heatworks was formed as a sister company to Frank's Fission and Fusion, by Harry Smith. This side of the Smith family’s collection of company focuses on manufacturing products and weapons that make use of the abundant energy provided by FFF. Much of these products come in the form of plasma technology, utilising extremely high energy sources to create destructive weaponry. Unlike most other manufacturers, Harry's Heatworks is not hired under contract by any civil governments, instead developing their products independently and then selling them off to similarly independent buyers.
Organisations

item.title: Lance Innovations
item.description:
Infobox Lance Innovations was an infantry equipment manufacturing company, operating from 514 to a few decades after the end of the Cosmian Wars. It is best known as the manufacturer credited for the introduction of modern coilguns as they are known today. Founded by Necto Unthur, it held a relatively firm grip on both the coilgun and melee weapon manufacturing scenes, although it often allowed smaller companies to slip through and create their own unique markets. This leniency kept it in business for more than a millennia, but in the end became what ultimately led to its eventual dissolution.
Organisations

item.title: Followers of the Black Pearl
item.description:
Infobox The Followers of the Black Pearl are a group that uses mind and thought manipulation technologies to indoctrinate members into their cult. The name of the cult originates from the starship that they inhabit, which has been painted matte black to match the darkness of space. This organisation focuses on pirate-like tactics, destroying ships in order to pillage resources and gain money, while kidnapping and indoctrinating the people from whom they steal from.
The Kolban Alliance has designated the Followers of the Black Pearl a public enemy. A massive bounty has been placed on the head of the leader Jack Jones and the rest of the cult’s leading body. Confirmed radar contact with the Black Pearl has been made several times over multiple years, but attempts to track and follow the ship have failed. The wreckages of their targets are still being found about four times a year.
Organisations

item.title: Grenund, Stav
item.description:
Infobox Stav Grenund was the founder of Grenund Constructive, a leading planetary ground equipment manufacturer. Grenund served for a short time in the Cindus Army, where he learnt about the ineffectiveness of much of its equipment. This prompted him to develop his own, which eventually earned him a position in the army's design facility, with several other engineering pioneers.
People

item.title: Borfrice, Becca
item.description:
Infobox Becca Borfrice is the founder and CEO of Borfrice Bionics Engineering Company. A Human coming from a historically mining-based family, Borfrice is the first in her family to hold any kind of leadership position. In an interview she explained she strove to begin a startup company after her father had his legs amputated after being seriously injured in a mining incident.
People

item.title: Jones, Jack
item.description:
Infobox Jack Jones is the leader of the criminal organisation known as the Followers of the Black Pearl and the owner of the “Black Pearl” starship. At the young age of 13, Jones began recruiting cabin mates to live with him in his dorms and assist him in criminal activity. His original motives were allegedly the theft of alcohol and drugs, but upon learning the amount profited from raiding vessels, his motives altered to piracy. Since the he began pirating starships, Jack Jones’ followership has grown, although not through conventional means. It is believed that the Linc's company of criminals use coercion and bribery in order to recruit new members.
People

item.title: Lender, Pilo
item.description:
Infobox Pilo Lender was the founder of the Fox Corporation, the highly successful weapons manufacturer part of the Symbiote Triangle. He was regarded as an ambitious pioneer who believed he could spearhead the technological progression of civilisation. Having served in the Xanfer military for a decade during the Cosmian Wars, Lender was greatly experienced. He had originally founded the Xanfer Military Manufacturing company in order to develop weapons for his civilisation's military during the wars. Highly respected in many regards by his own people due to the success of his corporation, Pilo served as a grand role model for the Xanfer during his lifetime.
People

item.title: Supreme Function
item.description:
Infobox Supreme Function is known as the organisation that fully triggered the start of the Cosmian Wars. Recognising the lack of political stability between the Linc and the Dottians, they formed a deal in secret with Richard Bleak and conspired to tip the two into a war so that Bleak Enterprise (who manufactured for the two civilisations on contract) could profit greatly from it. According to later investigations, they planned to split the total earnings amongst themselves. Supreme Function was finally disbanded when the unnamed Dottian leader was killed by a multiracial raid on one of their operating compounds in 1721.
Organisations

item.title: Bleak, Richard
item.description:
Infobox A Human born to a wealthy family, Richard Bleak was the founder of Bleak Enterprise, the mining and manufacturing company infamous for its controversial involvement in the Cosmian Wars. Before the wars started, he was widely respected as a helper and benefactor of all civilisations. However, later investigations described a history of fraud and other crime, including his dealings with the terrorist group Supreme Function.
People

item.title: Turf, Pas
item.description:
Infobox Pas Turf was the founder of Turf Mining, a successful mining company involved in the Cosmian Wars. Turf Mining remains active to this day, especially in the Xanfer, Human and Linc astral territories, with Turf retaining a well-known legacy.
People

item.title: Unthur, Necto
item.description:
Infobox Necto Unthur was the founder of Lance Innovations, a largely successful general equipment manufacturing company. Although Lance Innovations is no longer in operation as a company, Unthur’s many contributions to society have not been forgotten. A memorial dedicated to the Sleethier was erected and unveiled on Quatol in 1773, outside where his company headquarters was located.
People

item.title: Symbiote Triangle
item.description:
The Symbiote Triangle is an unofficial but widely applied term used to refer to the three largest and most influential corporations in the manufacturing market. The manufacturers the term is applied to are usually defined as the "three corporations you need to start a galactic war”. For the previous 150 years the three companies made part of the Symbiote Triangle have been the Fox Corporation, Primus Manufacturing and Sideways Collective Industries. Experts project that this will not change for an extended period of time, or until a new unexpected shift occurs (such as a war on the scale of the Cosmian Wars).
It is unknown exactly who coined the term for the Symbiote Triangle, but it is known that it has existed for several centuries. The term first became popular when Bleak Enterprise was starting up, just before the beginning of the Cosmian Wars. The phrase itself is believed to have originally begun as "three people you need to start a war", with reference to a weapons and equipment manufacturer (currently the Fox Corporation), a starship manufacturer (currently Sideways Collective Industries) and an ammunition manufacturer (currently Primus Manufacturing). However, around the beginning of the 20th century, after the introduction of the more modern organisations and the implementation of more widespread industrialisation plans, it was shifted to replace the "people" with "corporations".
General Information

item.title: Wellings, Irman
item.description:
Infobox Irman Wellings was a Human physicist and engineer best known for his personal project which resulted in the invention of Quantum Mass Projection, an efficient method of interstellar travel that utilises Green's Second Theorem and quantum holography to transmit mass over extremely long distances. He is also attributed for its unofficial nickname, Green Warping.
People

item.title: Wethal, Antill
item.description:
Infobox Antill Wethal was the founder of GoalKeep, the Kolban Alliance's official investigative bureau. Assassinated by a criminal organisation under investigation, many of the Human's future plans were put on hold indefinitely. The individual assassin was never identified and the investigation went cold, but GoalKeep still remains in operation today, six centuries on.
People

item.title: Assimilis, Aerin
item.description:
Infobox A Wythin of high stature, Aerin Assimilis was the founder of both Aerolite Mining Corps and Aerotech, two very long-running companies. A well recorded pioneer in the sciences, Assimilis was a consistent advocate for peace amongst the Wythin, and a fair amount of their peaceful policies can be at least partially attributed to him. Since his death the leadership positions in both of his companies have been passed down to the eldest son of the family.
People

item.title: Background Information
item.description:
This article focuses on various pieces of background or contextual information, that are either too insignificant to warrant the creation of their own individual article or are too difficult to categorise.The vast majority of people venture into space relatively early on in their lives. Most coming from working-class families experience exoatmospheric travel for the first time when they first get a job, enrol in a military or begin attending tertiary education. Citizens from middle-class or, more often than not, wealthier families, tend to see space for the first time in private starships much earlier on.Some never experience exoatmospheric travel a single time in their lifetimes. This can be for a range of reasons, such as not being able to afford it or simply liking having their feet planted firmly on the ground. Occasionally one may have a crippling fear of space, which can prevent them from ever trying it out.Starships cannot reach extremely high speeds by simply accelerating for long amounts of time due to constraints and limitations created by fuel usage and thruster efficiency. Another reasoning is general safety - it’s hard to fly something when you’re travelling faster than you can reasonably think.
General Information
